CREATE TABLE "public"."addresses" (
  "address_line" text NOT NULL,
  "city" text NOT NULL,
  "country" text NOT NULL,
  "hotel_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "latitude" numeric(9,6),
  "longitude" numeric(9,6),
  "postal_code" text NOT NULL,
  "state" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."amenities" (
  "category" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."booking_rooms" (
  "booking_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "nights" int4 NOT NULL,
  "price_per_night" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "quantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "room_type_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."bookings" (
  "adults" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "booking_number" text NOT NULL,
  "cancel_reason" text,
  "cancelled_at" timestamptz,
  "check_in" date NOT NULL,
  "check_out" date NOT NULL,
  "children" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "coupon_id" uuid,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "discount" numeric(10,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "hold_expires_at" timestamptz,
  "hotel_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "payment_status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "rooms" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "subtotal" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "tax" numeric(10,2) DEFAULT '0'::numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "total_amount" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "bookings_payment_status_check_e36f7f9e" CHECK ("payment_status" IN ('PENDING', 'AUTHORIZED', 'PAID', 'FAILED', 'REFUNDED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED')),
  CONSTRAINT "bookings_status_check_77e76a7c" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'PAYMENT_PENDING', 'CONFIRMED', 'CHECKED_IN', 'CHECKED_OUT', 'CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED', 'EXPIRED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."coupons" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "discount_type" text NOT NULL,
  "discount_value" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
  "usage_limit" int4,
  "used_count" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "valid_from" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "valid_to" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "coupons_discount_type_check_8c8ea4be" CHECK ("discount_type" IN ('PERCENTAGE', 'FIXED_AMOUNT')),
  CONSTRAINT "coupons_status_check_eb55a64b" CHECK ("status" IN ('DRAFT', 'ACTIVE', 'EXPIRED', 'DISABLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."favorites" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "hotel_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."hotel_amenities" (
  "amenity_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "hotel_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("hotel_id", "amenity_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."hotel_images" (
  "hotel_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "image_url" text NOT NULL,
  "is_primary" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "sort_order" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."hotels" (
  "check_in_time" text DEFAULT '14:00' NOT NULL,
  "check_out_time" text DEFAULT '11:00' NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "owner_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "star_rating" int4,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'DRAFT' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "hotels_status_check_0c3a2ffa" CHECK ("status" IN ('DRAFT', 'PENDING_APPROVAL', 'ACTIVE', 'REJECTED', 'SUSPENDED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notifications" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "read_at" timestamptz,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "notifications_type_check_c77e24ed" CHECK ("type" IN ('BOOKING', 'PAYMENT', 'CANCELLATION', 'REFUND', 'PROMOTION', 'SYSTEM'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."payments" (
  "amount" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "booking_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "currency" text DEFAULT 'INR' NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "order_id" text NOT NULL,
  "paid_at" timestamptz,
  "provider" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "transaction_id" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "payments_status_check_c6292004" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'AUTHORIZED', 'PAID', 'FAILED', 'REFUNDED', 'PARTIALLY_REFUNDED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."refunds" (
  "amount" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "payment_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "provider_id" text,
  "reason" text,
  "refunded_at" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."reviews" (
  "booking_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "comment" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "hotel_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "rating" int4 NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "reviews_status_check_ba5fd2ab" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'PUBLISHED', 'HIDDEN', 'REJECTED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."room_inventory" (
  "available_rooms" int4 NOT NULL,
  "date" date NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "is_closed" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "price" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "room_type_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."room_types" (
  "base_price" numeric(10,2) NOT NULL,
  "bed_type" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "hotel_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "max_adults" int4 DEFAULT 2 NOT NULL,
  "max_children" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "total_rooms" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "room_types_bed_type_check_e9ae1490" CHECK ("bed_type" IN ('SINGLE', 'DOUBLE', 'QUEEN', 'KING', 'TWIN', 'BUNK'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "clerk_id" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "password_hash" text,
  "phone" text,
  "role" text DEFAULT 'CUSTOMER' NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "users_role_check_529998aa" CHECK ("role" IN ('CUSTOMER', 'HOTEL_OWNER', 'HOTEL_MANAGER', 'ADMIN')),
  CONSTRAINT "users_status_check_3a7c0f48" CHECK ("status" IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED', 'DELETED'))
)
